topic: Why the stock market just crashed

beats.text: The market just imploded – 4% of the S&P vanished in minutes. What happened?
The Top
By 4:00 PM ET the S&P 500 fell 4.4% to 7,353.73, the Dow slipped 3.4% to 51,523.06, and the Nasdaq dropped 5.5% to 24,315.
beats.label: Indices close

beats.text: Tech led the rout – the Nasdaq sits 11.9% below its recent high of 27,599.79, driven by Nvidia’s 9.3% plunge.
beats.label: Tech pressure

beats.text: We lost billions today.
What triggered the cascade?
lines: Margin calls activated across leveraged accounts
Algorithmic traders reversed positions en masse
Retail investors joined the sell wave

beats.text: The Cracks
Picture a dam where one crack lets water rush out.
Now imagine a house of cards collapsing as a single chip falls.
Nvidia fell to 181.6, a 9.3% drop.

beats.text: That price sits 24.1% below its recent high of 239.24.

beats.text: Nvidia is the canary.
